entries.t: <FACE:03>Wow…<NL>A city of the future…<WAIT><FACE:19>The streets look like<NL>model homes, sir<WAIT><FACE:14>A bit too tidy… feels<NL>kind of chilly…
<FACE:08>Oh! Looks like we can<NL>rest here too!
<FACE:04>What's this? A pressed<NL>flower bookmark?<WAIT><FACE:05>Let me see?<NL>
<FACE:08>Ew! The petals fell<NL>off, just one left!<WAIT><FACE:06>How shabby!<NL>This flower's a flop!
<FACE:07>Oh, please!<NL><WAIT>As if I'd want that<NL>Take it if you like
<FACE:05>But what do you want<NL>with it?<WAIT><FACE:0A>Even with one petal,<NL>a flower's a flower…<WAIT><FACE:0B>You're pretty callous
<FACE:00>Easy, Hiyori<NL><WAIT>But Fubuki, is that<NL>a friend's bookmark…?
<FACE:0E>Sorry, <PLAYER>…<NL>not right now…<WAIT><FACE:0A>I can tell you this:<NL><WAIT>There's a very strong<NL>Medafighter nearby<WAIT>Be careful…<WAIT><FACE:00>Got it<NL>

<FACE:05>That's not all!<NL><WAIT>That girl over there…<NL>I've seen her before!<WAIT>She suddenly forced a<NL>Robattle on me!<WAIT>I knew she was shady…<NL>She's a Sperobo!<WAIT>Let's watch from here<NL>and unmask her!
<FACE:1F>My… and I was even<NL>going easy on you
<FACE:80>Amazing-robo… In the<NL>Gang she'd be a Boss!
<FACE:1F>My, a Boss's chair<NL>doesn't interest me<WAIT><FACE:1E>What interests me is<NL>this Cluster…<WAIT>You will lend me your<NL>strength as well!
<FACE:7F>Then our Sperobo Gang<NL>wants the same-robo!<WAIT>Let's team up-robo!
<FACE:1E>No!<NL><WAIT>I don't want to take<NL>this Cluster…<WAIT>I want to destroy it!<NL>
<FACE:1E>Our aims are not the<NL>same at all
<FACE:0A>…This is your bookmark<NL>It fell… one petal…<WAIT>You've kept it all<NL>this time…
<FACE:06>Don't be so casual!<NL><WAIT>That Rainy has a cute<NL>face, but she hit me!<WAIT>Fubuki might be one of<NL>her friends…
<FACE:06>Aren't they plotting<NL>something together?<WAIT>That's why he said<NL>nothing before!
<FACE:18>Leader…<WAIT><FACE:18>Leader, can't you tell<NL>us it isn't so?
<FACE:1E>My… Fubuki, of all<NL>people, what a slip!
<FACE:1E>I'll be taking this<NL>Block!<WAIT><FACE:1F>I'll expand my power<NL>to scare my brother!

<FACE:1E>If you want this Block<NL>too, try to beat me!<WAIT><FACE:05>You… what's your<NL>relation to Fubuki?<WAIT><FACE:20>Didn't he tell you?<NL><WAIT><FACE:1E>Fubuki and I have been<NL>close a long while!
<FACE:1D>Then… the leader's<NL>in on it after all…<WAIT><FACE:18>No way… that's cruel,<NL>leader…
<FACE:0B>Everyone!<NL>Lady Rainy must stop…<WAIT>I have to stop her…<NL>Please! Help me out!
<FACE:06>Saying that now…<NL>You won't fool me!<WAIT><FACE:06>You're friends with a<NL>Cluster-wrecker!<WAIT>I can't trust you now!
<FACE:15>Right! Keeping secrets<NL>You're no leader now!<WAIT><FACE:1A>You're out as leader!

<FACE:01>We've fought together<NL>as a team, right?!<WAIT><FACE:04>Sure, he seems to be<NL>hiding something…<WAIT>But Fubuki himself<NL>hasn't told us yet<WAIT><FACE:01>…He's got his reasons!<NL>We all have secrets!
<FACE:06>But Rainy says she'll<NL>destroy the Cluster!<WAIT><FACE:15>Right, right! Secrets<NL>aren't a small thing!
<FACE:04>But… I've got… I've<NL>got a secret too…<WAIT><FACE:0A><PLAYER>!
<FACE:04>This Medal was lying<NL>in that cave…<WAIT>I picked it up in<NL>secret and kept it…
<FACE:04>But… somehow it felt<NL>better if I kept it…
<FACE:03>You knew?<WAIT><FACE:05>Yeah, sort of…<NL>But so what?<WAIT><PLAYER>, you worried<NL>over it enough… And…<WAIT><FACE:07>That Medal suits you<NL>pretty well
<FACE:16>Right, right!<NL>You use it well!<WAIT><FACE:19>You've mastered it!
<FACE:05>…Fine, <PLAYER>…<NL><WAIT><FACE:07>For the softie you are<NL>I'll believe you now
<FACE:1E>Now then, Sperobos!<NL><WAIT>Beat this and I might<NL>consider joining you
<FACE:0E>Lady Rainy… I'll give<NL>this bookmark back…<WAIT><FACE:0A>Please fall back to<NL>Lobby Block and Earth
<FACE:14>Fub… I mean, leader…<NL><WAIT>You really are our<NL>leader after all!<WAIT><FACE:19>That's right!<NL>It just fits better!<WAIT><FACE:0A>Everyone…
<FACE:05>That's true<NL><WAIT>Besides, like us, you<NL>have someone to find…<WAIT><FACE:07>So we've all got one<NL>goal!<WAIT><FACE:0C>Right…
